title: Franco and Skorzeny launch saucer-shaped rockets from Spain

tellings.quote: There are these newspaper reports in Spain >> that Otto Scorzani is with General Franco >> on the Mediterranean coast and they're launching saucershaped rockets toward America,

plain: In 1946, according to newspaper reports in Spain, the Spanish dictator Francisco Franco and the former Nazi commando Otto Skorzeny were on the Mediterranean coast launching saucer-shaped rockets toward America. The philosopher Jason Jorjani tells Michels this as something he has read, drawing on a book called Saucer Swastikas and SCOPS and the writer Joseph P. Farrell, and he raises it because it would suggest some flying saucers of the time were Nazi-built craft carried on after the war.
